changeSet.sql: WITH profiles AS ( SELECT n, (310000 + n)::BIGINT AS user_id, CASE n % 7 WHEN 0 THEN 'LEFT' WHEN 1 THEN 'CENTRE_LEFT' WHEN 2 THEN 'CENTRE' WHEN 3 THEN 'CENTRE_RIGHT' WHEN 4 THEN 'RIGHT' WHEN 5 THEN 'NOT_POLITICAL' ELSE 'NOT_SURE' END AS political_persuasion, CASE n % 8 WHEN 0 THEN 'AGE_18_19' WHEN 1 THEN 'AGE_20_24' WHEN 2 THEN 'AGE_25_34' WHEN 3 THEN 'AGE_35_44' WHEN 4 THEN 'AGE_45_54' WHEN 5 THEN 'AGE_55_64' WHEN 6 THEN 'AGE_65_74' ELSE 'AGE_75_84' END AS age_range, CASE n % 5 WHEN 0 THEN 'WOMAN' WHEN 1 THEN 'MAN' WHEN 2 THEN 'NON_BINARY' WHEN 3 THEN 'WOMAN' ELSE 'MAN' END AS gender, CASE n % 10 WHEN 0 THEN 'SOUTH_ASIAN' WHEN 1 THEN 'BLACK_AFRICAN' WHEN 2 THEN 'EAST_ASIAN' WHEN 3 THEN 'MIXED_MULTIPLE' WHEN 4 THEN 'MIDDLE_EASTERN_NORTH_AFRICAN' ELSE 'WHITE_EUROPEAN' END AS race, CASE n % 8 WHEN 0 THEN 'London' WHEN 1 THEN 'Birmingham' WHEN 2 THEN 'Manchester' WHEN 3 THEN 'Leeds' WHEN 4 THEN 'Bristol' WHEN 5 THEN 'Glasgow' WHEN 6 THEN 'Cardiff' ELSE 'Newcastle' END AS region, CASE n % 4 WHEN 0 THEN 'URBAN' WHEN 1 THEN 'URBAN' WHEN 2 THEN 'SUBURBAN' ELSE 'RURAL' END AS urban_rural, CASE n % 8 WHEN 0 THEN 'NO_FORMAL_QUALIFICATIONS' WHEN 1 THEN 'SECONDARY_SCHOOL' WHEN 2 THEN 'VOCATIONAL_TECHNICAL' WHEN 3 THEN 'HIGHER_EDUCATION_BELOW_DEGREE' WHEN 4 THEN 'BACHELORS' WHEN 5 THEN 'MASTERS' WHEN 6 THEN 'DOCTORATE' ELSE 'OTHER' END AS education, CASE n % 8 WHEN 0 THEN 'STUDENT' WHEN 1 THEN 'EMPLOYED_FULL_TIME' WHEN 2 THEN 'EMPLOYED_PART_TIME' WHEN 3 THEN 'SELF_EMPLOYED' WHEN 4 THEN 'CASUAL_GIG_TEMP' WHEN 5 THEN 'UNEMPLOYED_LOOKING' WHEN 6 THEN 'CARER_HOMEMAKER' ELSE 'RETIRED' END AS occupation, ((n % 7) + 1) AS personal_income_tier, CASE n % 10 WHEN 0 THEN 'PRIVATE_RENT' WHEN 1 THEN 'PRIVATE_RENT' WHEN 2 THEN 'PRIVATE_RENT' WHEN 3 THEN 'PRIVATE_RENT' WHEN 4 THEN 'SOCIAL_RENT' WHEN 5 THEN 'OWN_MORTGAGE' WHEN 6 THEN 'OWN_MORTGAGE' WHEN 7 THEN 'OWN_OUTRIGHT' WHEN 8 THEN 'OWN_OUTRIGHT' ELSE 'LIVE_WITH_FAMILY' END AS housing_status, CASE n % 6 WHEN 0 THEN 'DETACHED' WHEN 1 THEN 'SEMI_DETACHED' WHEN 2 THEN 'TERRACED' WHEN 3 THEN 'FLAT_APARTMENT' WHEN 4 THEN 'ROOM_SHARED_HOUSE' ELSE 'OTHER_UNKNOWN' END AS property_type FROM generate_series(0, 999) AS n ), scored_profiles AS ( SELECT *, LEAST(92, GREATEST(20, 62 + CASE housing_status WHEN 'PRIVATE_RENT' THEN 14 WHEN 'SOCIAL_RENT' THEN 12 WHEN 'LIVE_WITH_FAMILY' THEN 8 WHEN 'OWN_MORTGAGE' THEN -3 WHEN 'OWN_OUTRIGHT' THEN -12 ELSE 0 END + CASE political_persuasion WHEN 'LEFT' THEN 8 WHEN 'CENTRE_LEFT' THEN 5 WHEN 'CENTRE_RIGHT' THEN -4 WHEN 'RIGHT' THEN -9 ELSE 0 END + CASE personal_income_tier WHEN 1 THEN 6 WHEN 2 THEN 5 WHEN 6 THEN -4 WHEN 7 THEN -7 ELSE 0 END + CASE age_range WHEN 'AGE_18_19' THEN 5 WHEN 'AGE_20_24' THEN 5 WHEN 'AGE_25_34' THEN 3 WHEN 'AGE_65_74' THEN -3 WHEN 'AGE_75_84' THEN -5 ELSE 0 END )) AS support_threshold FROM profiles ) INSERT INTO votes (post_id, user_id, option_id, characteristic_snapshot) SELECT 1046, user_id, (SELECT id FROM post_vote_option WHERE post_id = 1046 AND semantic_key = CASE WHEN ((n * 73 + 19) % 100) < support_threshold THEN 'AGREE' ELSE 'DISAGREE' END), jsonb_build_object( 'politicalPersuasion', political_persuasion, 'ageRange', age_range, 'gender', gender, 'race', race, 'country', 'United Kingdom', 'region', region, 'urbanRural', urban_rural, 'education', education, 'occupation', occupation, 'personalIncomeRange', 'income|GB-GBP-GROSS-2025-v1|PERSONAL|PERSONAL_TIER_' || personal_income_tier, 'personalIncome', jsonb_build_object( 'answerVersion', 2, 'profileId', 'GB-GBP-GROSS-2025-v1', 'profileVersion', 1, 'marketCode', 'GB', 'currencyCode', 'GBP', 'measure', 'PERSONAL', 'bandId', 'PERSONAL_TIER_' || personal_income_tier, 'relativeTier', 'TIER_' || personal_income_tier ), 'housingStatus', housing_status, 'propertyType', property_type ) FROM scored_profiles ORDER BY user_id;
